title: Multicolour Ramsey R(3,3,3)=17 (formalize-only)
recommendation: Genuinely NEW proof layer beyond the closed ramsey-r33/r35 infra: multicolour edge colourings (3 colours) instead of graph/complement pairs. Upper bound R(3,3,3)<=17: hand degree-counting (green degree >= 6 forces mono green triangle by ramsey33_on_finset; else all degrees <=5 => 16*5=80 odd sum of 16 odd degrees, contradiction — same parity vocabulary as the OPE-44 R(3,4) argument). Lower bound R(3,3,3)>16: explicit 120-edge certificate over Fin 16 (F_2^4 construction; Scout-verified zero mono triangles offline 2026-08-25), checked in Lean by decidable enumeration — same pattern as vdw24_gt_34. Mathlib gap re-grepped v4.10.0 this run: no Ramsey theorem, no multicolor/MColoring/RamseyNumber content anywhere upstream.
mathlib_gap_grep_2026_08_25: grep -ril ramsey over .lake/packages/mathlib/Mathlib hits only HalesJewett.lean / Hindman.lean prose + RingTheory false positives (Hopf algebras); 'multicolor|MColoring|RamseyNumber' => ZERO hits; Turan.lean exists (negative control OK).

statement_pin_required.convention: Edge k-colouring of the complete graph on Fin n as f : Fin n -> Fin n -> Fin k (symmetric, irreflexive); monochromatic triangle = exists distinct a b c with f a b = f a c = f b c.
landmines: Diagonal convention: pin f a a = default or state irreflexivity explicitly — off-diagonal extraction must not depend on it
Symmetry: require f a b = f b a for a != b (or use Sym2 encoding); pin ONE and note the other
Certificate edge order for native_decide: lexicographic (i,j), i<j — same convention as the W(2,4)>34 witness34 string
statement_pin_required.canonical_source: Greenwood & Gleason, Combinatorial relations and chromatic graphs, Canadian J. Math. 7 (1955) 1–7 (R(3,3,3)=17; also their R(3,3)=6 method)

feasibility_shape: Level A: definitions + lower bound via certificate + decidable check (1 heartbeat). Level B: upper bound hand argument (parity + ramsey33 pullback) (1 heartbeat). No witness search in Lean; no native_decide blowup (120 edges).
infra_carry_over: ProofLab/Ramsey.lean: RamseyUpper-style predicates, HasClique, ramsey33_fin6 / ramsey33_clique_inside_finset / ramsey33_on_finset (pullback to Finset of size 6 inside Fin 16), extract3/extract4
ProofLab/VanDerWaerden.lean: witness-string + native_decide pattern from vdw24_gt_34 (OPE-455, PR #33)
Degree-sum/parity lemmas (sum_degrees_even, not_regular_odd_of_odd_card) — need k-colour generalization (sum over colour classes)
scout_probes: Random search FAILS to find a K_16 witness (300k trials) — but Greenwood-Gleason F_2^4 construction succeeds deterministically; certificate r333_witness.txt verified independently (zero mono triangles, 3 colours used)
